newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: ABB in Norsk Hydro deal.
newsitem.headline: ABB in Norsk Hydro deal.

text.p: ZURICH, June 9 (Reueter) - Swiss-Swedish engineering firm ABB Asea Brown Boveri Ltd said it had received an order from Norsk Hydro for a subsea oil separation plant.
ABB said the order was the first of its kind and represented a "technological breakthrough on underwater processing plants."

No monetary value was stated in the announcement of the order. The order is for a complete subsea oil separation and injection plant for the Troll C oil field, located in the Norwegian sector of the North Sea.
ABB said it would be the world's first commercial application of such technology, which separates oil and water in a plant located on the sea bed.
Installation is to begin immediately. Completion is scheduled for early 1999, ABB said. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
